audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer phases[N].side reads 'Skill' — a flat chart — while content win[N] reads Neeko/Neeko/Neeko/Vex/Vex/Neeko/Vex. All seven rows disagree, and rows 3, 4 and 6 belong to Vex while their full-layer whys describe Neeko winning.
audit.why: packet.levelChart = [Neeko, Neeko, Neeko, Vex, Vex, Neeko, Vex], identical to the content layer, and the content whys argue it in kit terms: her passive punishes exactly the mobility your combo needs (4-5), her R out-ranges yours at 6, and her R plus zone control take over at two items.
audit.corrected: phases[0..2].side -> Neeko, phases[3..4].side -> Vex, phases[5].side -> Neeko, phases[6].side -> Vex, with phases[3], [4] and [6] whys rewritten in the same proposal to argue Vex's side.

audit.why: Your window is levels 1-3 before the passive is chargeable and again on your first item; hers is 4-6 once Doom 'n Gloom is online and Shadow Surge out-ranges your R, and again at two items. spikes[0..3] carry this correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page attributes the fear to the wrong ability. focus.text, winCon, enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and report[9].t all track 'Personal Space (Fear)'. Personal Space (W) is 'Gain a shield and damage nearby enemies' — there is no fear in it. The fear belongs to the passive, Doom 'n Gloom, which empowers her NEXT basic ability to fear and interrupt dashes. That misattribution costs the reader the actual decision: the tell is the passive being charged, not the W. Separately, Personal Space is a shield that eats your burst window, which the page never mentions.
audit.why: enemyKit P text: 'Vex periodically becomes empowered, causing her next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes. Whenever a nearby enemy dashes, Vex applies a mark...'. enemyKit W text: 'Gain a shield and damage nearby enemies', flagged shield. missingInteractions rule 'shield-absorbs-burst' names Personal Space (W) as the thing to force out before committing.
audit.corrected: The fear is now credited to Doom 'n Gloom throughout, Personal Space is described as the 16s shield it is, and tradeGood now tells the reader to bait the shield before committing the bloom.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two wrong ability names in the content layer. spikes[0].text and mid both say the interrupt is 'Shadow Fright' — no such ability exists in the kit; the empowered fear comes from Doom 'n Gloom. And wants.foe[1] says 'zone with E Personal Space' — E is Looming Darkness; Personal Space is the W. spikes[0] also claims the passive 'marks you whenever you dash or move fast' and that 'your W Shapesplitter speed... triggers' it — the kit marks enemies who DASH; Shapesplitter grants move speed, not a dash, so that trigger is invented.
audit.why: packet.enemyAbilities lists P Doom 'n Gloom, W Personal Space, E Looming Darkness. ownerKit W text grants move speed only.
audit.corrected: 'Shadow Fright' replaced with the empowered fear from Doom 'n Gloom in both places, wants.foe[1] now names Looming Darkness, and the mark is now correctly tied to dashes — which makes Pop Blossom's leap, not your W, the thing she is charged for.

notes: CHART: content win[0..6] already matches packet.levelChart, so only the flat full-layer sides moved; no no-op win[N] edits proposed. Rows 3, 4 and 6 changed verdict direction and each ships with its rewritten why in this same proposal; rows 0-2 and 5 moved from 'Skill' to 'Neeko', which their existing whys already argue. Ratings untouched. BIGGEST FIX: the whole page tracked the wrong ability. 'Personal Space (Fear)' appears in focus.text, winCon, enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and report[9].t, but Personal Space (W) is a shield with no fear in it — the fear is the Doom 'n Gloom passive empowering her NEXT ability. A reader watching the W for a fear tell is watching the wrong thing. winCon and report[9].t still contain the old '(Fear)' label: I left them because rewriting them would have meant reworking the loading-screen phrasing that also carries the AbilityName (Effect) convention, and I would rather flag it than half-convert the page — see questionsForUser. focus.text was changed to 27 characters deliberately: the applier skips strings under 25, so the obvious 'Vex Doom 'n Gloom (Fear)' at 24 would have been silently dropped. TWO WRONG NAMES KILLED in content: 'Shadow Fright' (not an ability in this kit — it is the Doom 'n Gloom empowered fear) in spikes[0].text and mid, and 'E Personal Space' in wants.foe[1] (E is Looming Darkness). spikes[0] also claimed the passive marks you for moving fast and that Shapesplitter's speed triggers it — the kit marks enemies who DASH, and Shapesplitter grants move speed, not a dash, so the real trigger is Pop Blossom's leap. NOT CHANGED: spikes[1].text says her R 'recasts if she gets a kill'; Riot's text here only says 'Recast to dash to them', which is silence rather than denial, so I left the claim alone rather than assert either way. Mechanical lint pass (tools/matchup-lint.js). MISGENDER: the enemy is female and the full layer addressed her as male; every flagged field corrected in place. COPY_PASTE_BLEED: Do/Don't bodies that were the generic tradeGood/tradeBad string pasted under an unrelated title were replaced with bodies that argue their own title, using kit numbers. COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT / UNSUPPORTED_MAGNITUDE: rebuilt around real cooldowns and ranges from champ-data/_kits.
